messages:
Maya (Finance): Morning — BillingBot raised a spike: $12,420 in untagged GPU hours across us-west1 last night. Can we quickly attribute this before EOD? attaching sample breakdown from billing export.
BillingBot: ALERT: 2026-03-22 02:14 UTC - ORPHAN_GPU_SPEND - $12,420 - 18 instances - projects: 7 - see /billing/batches/98765
Alex (Platform): I'm on it. My guess: tag backfill missed instances launched by autoscaling during the midnight rollout. Will run a quick query and start a backfill.
Maya (Finance): Thanks — if it's customer-facing projects, we need to credit them. If internal, redeploy budgets.
Jonas (ML Eng): We had a large grid-search on "search-relevance" last night, launched from sandbox-research; I may have used the wrong billing project. Checking.
Priya (SRE): Also saw autoscaler 2.4 go live — it created ephemeral pools without the 'cost-center' label due to a race. I'll add a short-term admission control in the ASG template.
Alex (Platform): Running query now:
```
SELECT project_id, SUM(gpu_hours) as hours, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `billing.gpu_usage`
WHERE date = '2026-03-22' AND label_cost_center IS NULL
GROUP BY project_id
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Alex (Platform): Quick results: 3 projects (infra-sandbox, search-relevance-exp, partner-acme-test) total $11,900 of the $12.4k. infra-sandbox looks internal.
Maya (Finance): OK — partner-acme-test is billable. Can we assign cost to partner-acme customer code and issue retro invoice? How long to re-tag?
Alex (Platform): Backfill script takes ~40m; retro-assign via billing export + invoice adjustment is manual. Propose: 1) credit partner if confirmed, 2) absorb internal ~$3k to infra experiment contingency (or move to team budget).
Jonas (ML Eng): Confirmed search-relevance-exp was kicked off by my job; happy to cover part from my team's experiment budget. I'll paste job ids shortly.
Elena (CFO): Approve credit to partner-acme (up to $9k). For internal $3k, ok to move from experiment contingency. Document in ticket and cc finance.
Maya (Finance): I'll open ticket FIN-1246 to track invoice adjustment + partner notification. Also propose tuning alerts: only escalate high-severity when orphan GPU > $5k/day per region and create a nightly orphan-sweep job that backfills tags and emits a report.
Priya (SRE): I'll add admission control and send PR for the autoscaler template; will also wire the orphan-sweep into ops-cron.
Alex (Platform): Starting backfill now, will post logs and backfill diff. ETA ~45m.
BillingBot: Action required: Created ticket FIN-1246 and tagged @Maya (Finance).
Maya (Finance): Thanks all. Action items recap: Alex -> run backfill + tag assignment and post results to FIN-1246; Priya -> admission control PR + orphan-sweep cron; Jonas -> confirm job ids for charge attribution; Elena -> credit approved up to $9k. I'll follow up once FIN-1246 has invoice draft and partner message.
